note: Every crafting item drop picks one item from this table, weighted by weight times its band's shift. The band is the item's material tier; common stays at 1x and rare, unique and mythic take the band shift (star_chart_tiers.csv band_shift times the chart's increased Item Rarity, 1x outside charts). Each source sets only how many drop and which items it may give. chart_only items drop only from Star Charts sources. Weights are the old tier 15 chart drops per 100 DP, rare and higher divided by tier 15's band shift (docs/analysis/chart_loot/rarity_band_model.js)
